[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]] ([[AG174]]-[[AG187]]) |java1=[[Yūji Ueda]] }} '''Harley's Cacturne''' (Japanese: '''ハーリーのノクタス''' ''Harley's Noctus'') is the main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} used by [[Harley]]. ==History== ===[[Hoenn]]=== [[File:Harley Cacturne Banette.png|thumb|left|220px|Cacturne with Banette at the Hoenn Grand Festival]] Cacturne debuted in ''[[AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse]]'', where it was used in the [[Purika City]] [[Pokémon Contest]]. In the Appeals Round, it used its {{m|Bullet Seed}} attack to draw frightening skull and crossbones on the stage. Its performance left [[Contest Judge|the three judges]] very impressed and easily granted [[Harley]] a place in the second stage. In the [[Contest Battle|Battle Round]], it was seen defeating an {{p|Azurill}} to reach the finals. There, it went up against [[May's Bulbasaur]]. It {{pkmn|battle}}d well but ended up being [[Fainting|knocked out]] by a powerful and beautiful [[Contest combination|combination]] of {{m|Razor Leaf}} and {{m|Petal Dance}}. After the Purika Contest, Cacturne was used in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]. In ''[[AG121|Hi Ho Silver Wind!]]'', it was called out to perform in the preliminary appeals stage. Using Bullet Seed, it scored 84 points for Harley, allowing him to advance to the main competition. In ''[[AG123|Rhapsody in Drew]]'', it battled alongside {{DL|Harley|Banette}} against May's Bulbasaur and {{TP|May|Beautifly}}. Despite the good start, Cacturne and Banette soon found themselves struggling to handle their opponents' impressive combinations and were eventually defeated, thus eliminating Harley from the tournament. ===[[Kanto]]=== [[File:Harley Wigglytuff and Cacturne.png|thumb|left|250px|Cacturne at the Kanto Grand Festival with Wigglytuff]] Cacturne was Harley's choice for the Appeals Round of the [[Saffron City]] [[Pokémon Contest]] in ''[[AG144|A Hurdle for Squirtle]]''. It created an interesting display by using the sharp needles from {{m|Needle Arm}} to cut through the fluffy cotton balls from {{m|Cotton Spore}}, demonstrating incredible precision and impressing the judges enough for them to grant Harley a place in the second round. In ''[[AG174|New Plot, Odd Lot!]]'', Cacturne was lent to [[Jessie]] as part of Harley's plan to ruin May's chances of entering the [[Kanto Grand Festival]]. Shortly after being sent out, it fell in love with Jessie. This happened because Harley and Jessie are soulmates, as explained by Harley himself. Jessie used Cacturne in the Appeals Round of the {{ci|Mulberry}} Contest. For its performance, Cacturne used Needle Arm and {{m|Cut}} to slice a carrot. It followed with Cotton Spore and used Bullet Seed to destroy the cotton-like spores and create a shower of sparkles. Its [[appeal]] was praised by the judges and easily grouped Jessie with the {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s advancing to the Battle Round. In ''[[AG181|Thinning the Hoard!]]'', Harley used Cacturne during his battle against May in the Kanto Grand Festival. It battled [[May's Munchlax]] and {{TP|May|Eevee}} along with {{DL|Harley|Wigglytuff}}. It was able to surprise {{cat|May's Pokémon}} and reduce her points but was quickly defeated by a combination of {{m|Focus Punch}} and {{m|Shadow Ball}}. In ''[[AG187|The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!]]'', Cacturne was used to expose {{TRT}} and send them blasting off after {{an|May}} and [[Drew]]'s battle. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Harley and Cacturne.png|thumb|220px|Cacturne and Harley]] [[File:Harley Cacturne love.png|thumb|left|220px|Cacturne fascinated by Jessie]] Cacturne is [[Harley]]'s main partner and the two seem to share a [[Friendship|strong bond]], with Harley often calling it "my buddy" when summoning it from its {{i|Poké Ball}}. Harley is immensely proud of his Cacturne and is easily offended when someone does not show Cacturne the same level of appreciation as he does. In ''[[AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse]]'', Harley felt insulted when May had to scan Cacturne with her [[Pokédex]]. He also did not like when she called Cacturne "scary." Similar to Harley's other Pokémon, Cacturne can be very menacing during [[Pokémon Contest]]s, displaying its [[move]]s and skills in such a way that it leaves the people watching it perform feeling very frightened, including the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]] and the [[Contest announcer|announcer]]. At the end of a [[Appeal|performance]], Cacturne is often seen posing with one of its arms on its hips just like its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Cacturne was shown to be good at [[Double Battle|two-on-two]] [[Contest Battle]]s, easily getting along with its teammates. It has been paired up with {{p|Banette}} and {{p|Wigglytuff}} and was able to battle in harmony with them. Cacturne is also quite skilled when it comes to performances, showing impressive precision when it used {{m|Needle Arm}} to cut through {{m|Cotton Spore}} in the {{ci|Saffron}} Contest. In ''[[AG174|New Plot, Odd Lot!]]'', Cacturne was fascinated by [[Jessie]] when Harley offered to loan his Pokémon for her to use in the {{ci|Mulberry}} Contest. According to Harley, Cacturne took a liking to Jessie because Harley and Jessie are alike in many aspects. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|grass|dark|Harley Cacturne {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bullet Seed|1=Poison Sting|2=Faint Attack}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bullet Seed|1=Poison Sting|2=Feint Attack}}|image2=Harley Cacturne {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}||0=Pin Missile|1=Needle Arm|2=Cotton Spore|3=Cut}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Pin Missile|1=Needle Arm|2=Cotton Spore|3=Cut}}}} {{anmov|grass|Bullet Seed|AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse|rec=yes}} {{anmov|poison|Poison Sting|AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse}} {{anmov|dark|Feint Attack|AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse}} {{anmov|bug|Pin Missile|AG123|Rhapsody in Drew}} {{anmov|grass|Cotton Spore|AG144|A Hurdle for Squirtle|rec=yes}} {{anmov|grass|Needle Arm|AG144|A Hurdle for Squirtle|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Cut|AG174|New Plot, Odd Lot!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|dark|c=l}} ==Trivia== * Cacturne is the only one of its [[Pokémon (species)|species]] to appear in {{aniseries|PTS}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Cacturne}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cacturne}} [[Category:Rivals' Pokémon]] [[de:Harleys Noktuska]] [[es:Cacturne de Harley]] [[fr:Cacturne d'Harley]] [[it:Cacturne di Harley]] [[ja:ハーリーのノクタス]] [[zh:哈利的梦歌仙人掌]]
